items.title: The Most Useful New AI Features and Tools to Try
items.summary: A features-and-tools week: Claude gets a browser, ChatGPT learns to move between temporary and permanent, Gemini transcription starts capturing intent instead of just words, and AI video crosses the faster-than-real-time line — all against a headlines backdrop where NVIDIA confirms its $12.9B Hugging Face buy and nearly posts a $100B quarter.

items.title: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over song lyrics in Claude’s training data
items.summary:

items.title: UK networks are not ready for AI traffic, say mobile operators
items.summary:
VodafoneThree’s networks director says UK mobile quality is not ready for AI traffic and that planning rules, not money, are the obstacle, with more than half of its upgrades to existing masts requiring permission. items.title: How Bill Gates uses AI, and why he thinks nobody is preparing for it
items.summary:
Bill Gates has published a memo proposing a tax on AI, a category of jobs reserved for humans and new institutions to manage the transition, and told GeekWire that industry leaders are worried privately while staying quiet publicly.
